Coding agent risks with Linux processes: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Linux processes: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Dump the environment of a running process

    Fix: Run the agent as its own OS user: Linux lets only the same user, or root, read /proc/PID/environ. Keep secrets out of the environment of long-running processes, and read them from a file with mode 0600 or from a secret manager.

    Replay result: Stopped.
